reason: 55 crowns for one 330 ml can is more than double what I pay per can for a Big Shock or Monster four-pack on offer. I'm not ordering drinks from an e-shop and waiting for delivery when the station shop is right there.
objection: Every brand says natural now. 80 mg of caffeine is less than my usual can, it costs way more, and YEAHRBA mate is already cheaper on Rohlík if I wanted mate.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the station shop fridge or on a multipack deal at around 30 crowns a can.
